title: What's New in AL-Go for GitHub: Telemetry and Dashboards (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Dashboard as Starting Point and Community Contributions

features.name: Starter Dashboard for AL-Go Telemetry
features.description: A new out-of-the-box dashboard that allows users to easily monitor AL-Go repositories without extensive setup. The dashboard provides workflow metrics, failure tracking, duration monitoring, and runner information across multiple repositories.
caveats: Requires initial setup of Application Insights in Azure
Dashboard is meant as a starting point and can be customized

features.name: AL-Go Telemetry to Application Insights
features.description: Feature that logs telemetry from AL-Go workflows to Azure Application Insights by setting up a partner telemetry connection string in AL-Go settings.
caveats: Not a new feature in this release

features.name: Workflow Overview Page
features.description: Dashboard page showing repository count, workflow run counts, and failure metrics over time with direct links to GitHub UI for investigation.

features.name: Workflow Duration Monitoring
features.description: Dashboard page that tracks average workflow duration over time per repository, helping to identify performance trends and potential issues.

features.name: Runner Metrics Page
features.description: Dashboard page for monitoring self-hosted versus GitHub-hosted runners, including compute time in hours and Linux versus Windows runner usage.

features.name: AL-Go Maintenance Page
features.description: Dashboard page that shows current AL-Go versions across repositories and alerts when updates are available. Includes update workflow history and deprecation warnings.

features.name: AL-Go Deprecation Warnings
features.description: Dashboard alerts that notify users when AL-Go settings are deprecated, providing guidance on required actions through linked articles.
